Rows that grant nothing

        
        

          These rows grant nothing, and the guard that refuses to remove
          the last admin does not count them.
        

        

          More
          

            Their account id is not in the form the service accepts — a
            row written straight into the database by hand arrives like
            this. What the guard holds back is the last row that really
            grants admin; these are neither counted by it nor kept by
            it, so a table with nothing else left in it has an admin
            list that is already empty.

Result

      

      
      

        Download CSV
        Download Excel
        Download JSON
      

      

      
      

        More
        

          Excel keeps the numbers as numbers, so a weight sorts as a
          weight and a handle of digits stays a handle. CSV is plain
          text that anything can read. JSON keeps the nesting the other
          two have to flatten — use it if something other than a person
          is going to read this.

Publish

      

        Sends the charts above to Muse's
        charts, replacing what is there now — counts and medians,
        no handles and no rows.
      


      

        
        
        

          Someone who knows what a person weighs may recognize their
          line — off by default for that reason.
        

        

          More
          

            Published as “Person 1”, “Person 2” — never handles — and
            each point is rounded to a date and a weight band, so
            following one person from one publication to the next is
            guesswork rather than a lookup. Publishing twice still
            discloses more than publishing once. Fewer than five lines
            publishes no chart at all.
          

        

      


      

        
        
      


      


      

    


    
    

      
Before you close this

      
      

        Press Clear before you leave this browser —
        the key stays on this device until you do.
      

      

        More
        

          This page is the only place the submissions exist in the
          clear. Closing the tab discards everything decrypted here, and
          the admin session is tab-scoped too — but the key is not. Once
          you import it, it stays on this device so later exports need
          no file. Keep your key file as well: the browser may drop
          stored data, and the file is what puts the key back.
